## Outcome

PR #1929 (`/fix --ci-cd: auto-generate and solve CI/CD remediation issues`) is **MERGEABLE / CLEAN**, not a draft, and all CI checks pass — https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/pull/1929

### What was finished in this session

1. **Resolved the repo-wide CI breakage** caused by `use-m@8.14.0` relocating its eval bundle from `use.js` to `src/use.js` (the unversioned unpkg URL began returning a `404 Not found` body that got `eval()`'d → `SyntaxError: Unexpected identifier 'found'`, breaking every command including on `main`):
   - `src/use-m-bootstrap.lib.mjs` now resolves the bundle through a prioritized candidate list (unpkg root → unpkg `src/` → jsdelivr root → jsdelivr `src/`), validating HTTP status and rejecting per-CDN error-page bodies (unpkg `Not found:`, jsdelivr `Couldn't find`/`Cannot find`/`Error:`/`Failed to`, raw HTML). The original unpkg URL stays first so the #1910 regression test still passes.
   - `src/hive.mjs` reuses the shared `loadUseMCode` helper instead of its hardcoded single URL (verified `ensureUseM` behavior is byte-for-byte unchanged — it never consumed `log`).
   - Added `tests/test-use-m-bootstrap-cdn-fallback.mjs` (7 tests). Verified the real-network bootstrap fetches 42,916 bytes with `hasUse: true`.

2. **Mirrored the `/fix` README section** into `README.zh.md`, `README.hi.md`, `README.ru.md` (the docs-language-sync test required it).

3. **Combined into a single changeset** (the repo enforces exactly one per PR) — folded the bootstrap-fix note into the `/fix --ci-cd` minor changeset.

4. **Fixed broken `./logs/` links** in the issue-1733 case-study README (`logs/` is globally git-ignored, so the placeholder could never be committed).

5. **Updated the PR description** to document the incidental bootstrap fix and the added tests.

### CI verification
- Full test matrix ran green on the code commit (567f50cc): `test-execution` ✅, `test-suites` ✅, `memory-check-linux` ✅, `Check for Changesets` ✅, `test-compilation` ✅, `lint` ✅.
- `validate-docs` ✅ on the docs runs.
- All 257 local test files pass; branch is 0 commits behind `main`; working tree clean.

## Working session summary

**PR #1929 is finished and ready for review** — all CI checks pass on the pushed head (`f835f3ba`): https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/pull/1929

What I completed in this final stretch:

**Case study redone** (`b278f950`) — refreshed the captured data (re-fetched issue #1733, added the PR #1929 comments where the feedback actually landed, added the re-titled web-capture#139), and rewrote the analysis against the updated description: what changed upstream and why, requirements R1–R25, and the reused-components map.

The most useful thing that came out of the re-analysis is a caveat I documented rather than papered over: the "omit parts provided by `--development-log`/`--deep-analysis`" rule is **not lossless**. `--development-log` collects into `./dev/log/issues/{id}/pulls/{pr}`, but the paragraph it displaces names `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` — a destination that actually comes from a *different* option, `--prompt-case-studies`. Dropping the paragraph redirects that instruction instead of preserving it. That's the intended outcome (the dev-log directory is the current convention per #1596), but it means the generated body must not be re-solved with a plain `/solve`. I corrected an earlier code comment that overclaimed the instruction was "never silently lost," and documented the trade-off in the case study §6 and the PR body.

**Changeset corrected** (`f835f3ba`) — it still advertised a use-m bootstrap CDN fallback, but that fix landed on main independently (pinned `use-m@8.13.8` + a "Not found" guard), and merging main left `src/use-m-bootstrap.lib.mjs` byte-identical. The PR doesn't touch that file, so the note described a change that isn't here. I verified main's protection exists before removing it, so nothing was lost.

**PR description rewritten** — it promised the Telegram handler as a "follow-up" (now implemented) and cited a test file that no longer exists on the branch.

One thing worth flagging: **four test files fail locally** (`test-hive.mjs`, `test-hive-no-silent-failure.mjs`, `test-opus-47/48-model-support.mjs`). I traced these rather than dismissing them — they fail **identically on unmodified `origin/main`** (same counts: 200/3, 161/5), and the root cause is that this machine runs **Node v20.20.2** while the repo requires **`>=24.0.0`**. CI on Node 24 is green across every job. So they're not regressions from this PR, but they do mean my local suite run can't be treated as a full pass — CI is the authority here, and it's clean.
